title: Find end-to-end tests the catalog is missing
statement: As a developer, I can see end-to-end test code that no catalog entry points at, so the catalog can really be all of our tests.
overview: Proposed addition. Trevor asked for a catalog of all end-to-end tests, and nothing else would show when it stops being all of them. Today this repository has 139 `test()` calls in 43 spec files, and test cases point at 11 of those files.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The QA section and `query e2e-catalog` list files in the declared paths with lines that no entry's code reference covers.
This list fails nothing unless a team writes its own rule over it.
The list works for any test framework, because it compares lines and does not parse tests.
